95)༄༅/bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gtor zlog bdud dpung zil gnon gyi 'don 'grigs nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi byin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/96)gsang

tei:div.tei:p: 95) ༄༅/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gtor zlog bdud dpung zil gnon gyi 'don 'grigs nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi byin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ 96)

gsang 'dzin bdag po lo chen rnam snang mdzad// gsang bstan spel ba'i byed por mngon 'phrul ba// gsang bdag gter bdag gling dang blo mtha' yas// gsang 'dzin dngos byon bla mar bcas la 'dud// gtor zlog bdud dpung zil gnon gyi// 'don 'grigs bdud tshogs mthar byed pa'i// lag len bdud kyi g.yul 'joms 'di// bdud dpung 'dul ba'i phyag char bri/ de la bca' shom dang*/ dngos so/ dang po ni/ mchod stegs dang por/ yi dam dpal gtor dmar po 'khor dgu/ mtheb skyu can/ g.yas g.yon rtsa gsum chos skyong tshe gtor bum gzugs dang zla gam/ chad brtan/ stegs gnyis par bskang gtor bcu'am lnga/ sman raka bcas/ stegs gsum par/ rgyun gtor/ g.yas nas zhi mchod/ g.yon nas drag mchod/ las dkyil dbus su zlog gtor 'khor brgyad/ mtheb skyu lha grangs/ de'i g.yas su rgyas pa gru bzhi ser po/ phyogs bzhir padma gyen lang re/ mtshams bzhir mtheb ril/ lto bar nor bu/ rtser nyi zla can/ g.yon du drag gtor gru gsum nag po/ 'khor brgyad/ mtheb skyu can/ rgyan med yungs dkar 'dzugs pa/ las dkyil mdun du zhi ba'i bla gtor dkar po/ de'i g.yas su khyung la dpal gtor dmar po 'khor dgu pa mtheb skyu can/ de'i g.yas su gter bdag gi gtor ma nyi zla can dang*/ sman thod/ bla gtor g.yon du dregs pa gru gsum dmar po 'khor rang 'dra lnga/ mtheb skyu nyer lnga/ de'i g.yon du gzhi bdag spyi gtor dkar zlum mtheb ril nyi zla can dang*/ 97) rakta/ g.yon nas brtsams pa'i nyer spyod bsham/ kong zor/ gtor zor/ mda' zor/ rdo zor/ khrag zor rnams dang*/ las phran gyi bcas/ rnga mong khyung zhon rdzas bcas/ srin mo za lam/ glud khru gang ba nam rgyang mda' 'phang sogs kyis brgyan pa/ srung 'khor bcu gsum/ bzlog 'khor bcu gcig bsad 'khor gsum/ gdan 'khor bcu/ khyung 'khor bco lnga/ rnams ci 'dzoms lag len man ngag gsal byed ltar bsag

༈ gnyis pa/ dngos gzhi la/ hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi= sogs/ siddhi hūm̐: kun khyab 'gyur med= dang*/ kun bzang bde stong= gnyis res mos/ rgyud 'debs/ khyab bdag ston pa= mthar rol mo byin rlabs la/ dung chen/ ḍā dril bcas/ 'ur/ sum rdung*/ rol mo bzhag badzra a mṛta= sogs phyag rgya bcas sngags rnams dang*/ gang dag 'dir gnas= mthar/ dung dkar bcas mchod rol/ oṃ hūṃ traṃ hrīḥ bya/ rang gi snying ga'i= sogs dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon= lan gsum/ sems can bde dang= lan gcig dzaḥhūm̐= tshogs zhing*/ rang gi spyi bor= yig brgya nyer gcig mgon po bdag ni= badzra ma hā= yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ dung chen bcas/ sum rdung gis/ hūm̐: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i= gdon mi za: hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa/ rgyas par kar gling zhi khro ltar bgegs bskrad rol mo sum khug ma/ bsdu 98) na bla ma dgongs 'dus ltar/ 'ur/ dgu rdung*/ hūm̐: bdag nyid las kyi= hūm̐: snang srid 'khor lo= kha sbub bsnol: rnga bcad la/ sum bha ni= 'dod rgyal rgya/ ind+ra ya: dril bsil/ hūm̐: bdag nyid thugs nas= rnga 'don/ 'joms: rnga gcad/ sngags lhug 'don/ hūm̐: bdag gi dpal gyi= hūm̐: thugs las= hūm̐: mi bzad khro gtum = hūm̐: ma bcos thig le= mthar 'ur sum rdung*/ ḍā dril dung chen bcas/ hūm̐: snang srid 'khor 'das= hūm̐: khams gsum ye nas= hūm̐: bla ma rig 'dzin= mthar yig brgya/ hūm̐: ye shes sku mchog= thal sbyar lhug 'don rdor sems ltar yin/ ho: khams gsum sems can= rnga 'don mthar/ rol bsu bcas 'ur bdun rdung*/ hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs= mthar/ 'ur bdun rdung gis 'jog/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: rang gi thugs ka nas= lhug 'don badzra arghaṃ= rang rgya/ mchod rol/ oṃ hūṃ= la/ dung chen rgya dkar/ ḍā dril/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ stong pa'i ngang las= sarba pañtsa= gsum/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: stong pa'i ngang las= ma hā rakta= gsum/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ stong pa'i ngang las rlung = ma hā bi ta= dza gad kyi bum pa=

nas bar 'grel/ a yurdzña na tshe bhrum̐ hūm̐/ sum rdung*/ hūm̐: rnam dag byang chub= mkha' la gsal/ rnga gcad/ nam mkhar gnas= 99)pa'i= lhug e las= rnga 'don/ bsnol mar gyur/ rnga gcad/ man lhug tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim= mtshams su skyed rdzogs chen po nam mkha'i lha skyed sbyar/ de yongs su= bzhugs pa'o: bar dang*/ gzhung gi yab kyi gsang gnas= hūm̐: dbus phyogs mi 'gyur= man rnga 'don/ hūm̐: bdag nyid dus gsum= mgo len/ dbang bskur ro: rnga gcad/ man lhug phyag rgya bcas gtang*/ badzra sa mā dza: rol bsu bcas 'ur sum rdung*/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings= sogs spyan 'dren mthar/ 'ur/ sum rdung*/ bzhugs gsol/ phyag 'tshal/ sman mchod kya ི khā hi= nas/ rnga gcad/ kun tu bzang po= man lhug 'don/ hūm̐: don dam= rnga 'don/ thugs mchog= la 'ur sum rdung*/ dwangs bsil rnyog med= rnga med/ gdangs phyag rgya bcas/ shabda la mchod rol kar gling zhi khro ltar/ 'dzam bu gser 'khor= nas/ gdangs phyag rgya/ ghandhe= la mchod rol zhi khro ltar la/ hūm̐: gdug pa can rnams= man rnga 'don/ gshin rje'i 'dun sa= mthar/ 'ur/ rkang gcig sum rdung*/ rgyu gnyis rkyen sbyar= nas rnga 'don/ bstod pa'i 'gor dgu rdung*/ mthar dgu rdung gsum dang*/ 'ur gsum rdung*/ dzab dmigs/ rang gi thugs rin po che= sogs dang*/ zhi sngags sum brgya/ ye shes lha tshogs= mchod rol oṃ hūm̐ ma re re bzhin sbyar/ de bzhin du khro bo (100) spyi sngags sum brgya/ stong tshig che mchog stong*/ stong tshig re re bzhin sbyar nas/ yang dag brgya/ gshin rje brgya/ rta mgrin brgya/ phur pa brgya/ ma mo/ lnga bcu/ rig 'dzin/ lnga bcu/ dregs sngags/ lnga bcu/ bka' sdod/ sum bcu/ drag sngags so lnga stong*/ thun rdzas la zhal phu zhu/ hūm̐: ye shes lha tshogs= zhi rol bcas bya/ ༈ de nas bka' srung rgyas par dngos rol ltar/ bla ma yi dam spyi gtor/ badzra a mṛ ta sogs nas/ shabda'i mthar zhi rol oṃ ham̐'u ma/

ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las= sngags rnams gsum re/ spyan 'dren dril ring dkrol/ mchod pa/ shabda 'i mthar zhi rol oṃ hūm̐ ma/ badzra pañtsa= sogs nas/ kun 'grub mdzod: bar/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta= nas phyag bzhi'i spyan 'dren rol bsu med/ dung chen/ rgya gling*/ dkar/ rkang bcas/ 'ur sum rdung*/ spyan 'dren mthar/ spro na/ 'ur sum rdung*/ tiṣṭhantuḥ rnga gcad nas dam bzhag lhug 'don/ chos sku 'gyur med= nas rnga 'don/ bi ta= 'phros rnga gcad/ dur khrod lha mo'i mdun skyed lhug spyan 'dren thog mtha' 'ur sum rdung re/ bzhugs gsol/ phyag 'tshal/ mchod pa rnams rnga 'don/ pra titstsha swa hā/ rnga gcad/ lha rnams kyi= lhug sngags 'bul lan gsum re rgya bcas/ dpal ma hā ka la= gtor gzhong rgya/ mchod 'bru gzung*/ phrin las mdzod cig mchod 'bru gtor/ hūm̐/ mi 'gyur rnam dag= nas rnga 'don/ bhyo/ mi 'gyur bed chen = 'go skul/ 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ 101) rnga gcad/ ༈ dregs pa/ rang nyid dpal chen por= lhug hūm̐/ sngon tshe dpal chen= rnga 'don/ shabda mthar/ rnga gcad/ sman raka sngags lhug gtor sngags lan gsum/ rgya bcas/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug ma= nas bcas/ thal sbyar/ phrin las mdzod cig 'bru 'thor/ hūm̐/ bde gshegs bka' yi= rnga 'don/ mchis par mdzod/ bar dang dam can spyi gtor gter gzhi gnyis gtang*/ badzra arghaṃ= la/ 'ur thung dang*/ (Musical notes and signs here) dung dkar/ dung chen 'bud/ yid la 'dod pa= mthar/ (Musical notes and signs here) 'ur/ sum rdung*/ mgon po lcam dral= lhug he ru ka bzhi spel yig brgya lan gsum/ badzra kro dha ma hā shṝ he ru ka= rgya/ phyag bzhi'i sngags gnyis dang*/ dur khrod lha mo'i sngags rnams nyer gcig re/ sha sa na= gsum/ oṃ shrī badzra dharma pā la= shabda'i mthar/ zhi rol oṃ hūṃ ma/ ma hā pañtsa a mri ta khā hi/ rnga 'don gyis/ hūm̐/ drag po sku lnga rgyal ba'i bka' sdod mchog /ye shes lnga ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga'i 'khor// phrin las bdud 'dul dgra bgegs kun gyi gshed// legs ldan 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gsan cing dgongs su gsol// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas dgyes par

102) mdzod// dam tshig 'gal 'khrul nyams chag mthol zhing bshags// thun mong mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ la dgu rdung gcig 'ur sum rdung*/ mthar tshogs grol na/ ༈ slar sum rdung gis las byang gi hūm̐/ rdo rje'i lta bu'i= spyan 'dren mgo mthar 'ur sum brdung re/ badzra la sye= la phyag rgya/ bla med mchog gi= rnga 'don/ bdag cag ma rig= yig brgya/ rol bsu bcas/ 'ur/ sum rdung*/ mdangs skong*/ hūm̐/ shar nas badzra= mthar dbyung*/ phud skong tshang ma rnga 'don/ sum rdung bka' srung skong ba/ badzra a mri ta nas/ spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ 'ur/ rkang*/ sum brdung*/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings bde ba= bhyo/ sgyu 'phrul klong nas= ho/ rang bzhin chos kyi= yig brgya/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i bstan srung grub/ dngos grub rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis 'byor bar mdzod/ ༈ 'ur/ dgu rdung gis las byang bstod pa/ hūm̐/ bde gshegs sku lnga'i= rnga 'don/ dpal gyi bka' sdod 'khor da la bstod/ dgu rdung gcig 'ur/ sum rdung/ gtor zlog bdud dpung zil gnon las/ mdun gyi ma tram= lhug 'don gyis/ dkyil 'khor chen por gyur: badzra kro dha la sarba karma= sbyar ba nyer gcig yang dag gshin rje/ rta mgrin/ phur pa/ ma mo/ rig 'dzin/ dregs 'dul/ drag sngags bcas la/ sarba karma yaksha re re sbyar ba nyer gcig re/ 103) snod bcud dkyil 'khor= mthar/ rol bsu/ 'ur/ dgu rdung gis/ hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings na= rnga 'don/ mthar/ thugs dam thugs rjes dgra bgegs myur du sgrol/ drag rol dgu rdung*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ gser skyems zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dung chen/ dkar/ rgya/ 'ur/ sum brdung*/ hūm̐: byin rlabs mchog stsol= mthar/ sum rdung*/ hūm̐ bhyo: ma bcos spros bral= rnga 'don/ dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: rnga gcad/ snod bcud lhar gsal= mthar/ dung chen bcas/ 'ur/ sum rdung/ ru tra sarba sha truṃ=

man lhug 'don/ 'gugs pa'i mgor dgu rdung*/ 'gugs pa snga ma gnyis la drag rol/ (Musical notes and signs here) phyi ma la drag rol dgu rdung*/ hūm̐: smug nag gru gsum= man nar 'don/ tshig lhug rnams rnga bcad nas 'don/ e yi chogs kyi= lha mo slas byan= mthing nag gru gsum= dam nyams dgra bo= ser nag gru gsum= dam tshig chen po'i= dmar nag gru gsum= dpal chen khrag 'thung= ljang nag gru gsum= ye shes chen po= smug nag gru gsum= brlag par gyis shig: 'di yan mtshams su drag rol dang dgu rdung*/ ci rigs sbyar/ phur pa byug bdug brab gsum bcas/ 104) oṃ badzra kī li sogs nas/ hūm̐: bdag nyid khrag 'thung = man rnga 'don/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rnga gcad/ phur pa de ye shes= lhug dgu rdung gis/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings nas= 'dur/ tshig mtshams rnga 'phar/ mtshams su drag sngags so lnga rol 'thab/ rnga 'ur/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: rdo rje phur pa= 'dur mtshams rnams rnga 'phar/ stobs chen 'dus pa mthar/ drag rol thing ma dgu thing*/ (Musical notes and signs here) e ma khams gsum= nas rnga 'don/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: lcags sam drag po'i= (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: nga ni sngags= nyams pa'i dgra bgegs rnams la= rnga 'phar/ bhyo bho: man ring 'phar/ mthar/ drag rol thing ma/ dgu thing*/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: stong pa'i ye shes= man 'dur/ tshig mtshams rnga 'phar sngags 'thab/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: che mchog dpal dgu'i= hūm̐: rdungs shig= hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum= sogs nas/ brlag par gyur cig: ༈ drag rol thing ma/ dgu thing nyis brtsegs/ hūm̐: phyes shig= man rnga 'don/ hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum nas/ lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du thob cigaḥ drag rol dgu rdung*/ ༈ las byang tshogs drang ba/ ho/ tshogs kyi mchod pa= bsam lhun rgyas bsdus gang rung*/

spro na bka' ma ltar cha gsum btang*/ he ru kaḥdapal grong khyer du// tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod pa yis// bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa// dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog 105) dung chen bcas/ sum brdung gis/ hūm̐: dang po phud kyi= kun byos shigaḥ rnga gcad/ oṃ āḥham̐'u pañtsa= lhug shabda mthar/ rol bsu/ 'ur bdun rdung gis/ ham̐'u: bde gshegs zhi khro= rnga 'don/ (Musical notes and signs here) sngags tshig bshugs pa'i brda yis mtshon nas kyang: zhes chad rdung*/ mkha' 'gro ging dang= man rnga 'don/ mthar kar gling zhi khro ltar lhag ma rgyas pa'am/ bla ma dgongs 'dus ltar 'ur dgu rdung gis 'phros nyid nas/ gtor zlog gi hūm̐: sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams: rnga 'don/ hūm̐: 'jig rten snod bcud= hūm̐: khro bo rol pa'i= gnyis mgo skul re/ ma hā rakta khā hi: 'phros/ rol bsu/ 'ur/ dgu rdung gis/ hūm̐: dpal chen che mchog= rnga 'don/ (Musical notes and signs here) che mchog yon tan lha tshogs rnams: sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs gnod pa'i sbyor ba zlogs: rol mtha'= 'ur/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: bcom ldan badzra= man rnga 'don dang*/ tshig mtha'i gsum re chol rgyag dang*/ rol 'thab bcas/ gong ltar dpal dgu la 'gre/ bka' sdod mthar rol 'thab/ (Musical notes and signs here) drag sngags brgyad cu lan nyer gcig dgu rdung gis/ hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal= rnga 'don/ mthar dgu rdung*/ hūm̐ hūm̐: 106) snang zhing srid pas= rdo rje dril bu nyid du zlogs: dgu rdung*/ oṃ hūm̐ trig khroṃ= nyer gcig rol bsu rgya gling bcas/ 'ur/ sum rdung*/ hūm̐: dad pa dang ni= rnga 'don/ spro na/ spyan 'dren mthar/ 'ur/ sum rdung*/ mchod pa mthar/ 'ur/ dgu rdung*/ hūm̐: 'dab chags rgyal po= rnga 'don/ dgu rdung*/ hūm̐: bcom ldan che mchog= rnga 'don/ dgu rdung gis/ hūm̐: bcom ldan che mchog=
ltas ngan dmigs kyi mthar dgu rdung*/ drag sngags so lnga/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍā= sbyar ba nyer gcig rol bsu/ 'ur/ dgu rdung*/ hūm̐: dbus kyi dpal chen=

rnga 'don/ sgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: dgu rdung*/ ༈ 'dir nyin snga ma rnams la/ 'og gi ltas ngan brgya bzlog hūm̐: khro rgyal khams gsum hūm̐ sgra= rnga 'don/ dgu rdung gis/ bhyo bhyo bhyo:dang po bhyo yis= rnga 'don/ sgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: drag rol/ dgu rdung gi 'jog ༈ nub snga ma rnams su dgu rdung gis/ las byang bskul pa/ mi mngon dbyings na= rnga 'don/ dgu rdung gis/ sngon tshe 'das dus= rnga 'don/ dgu brdung gis/ hūm̐: tshogs dang bka' yi= nas/ ma ma sring 'gro ma hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ hūm̐: 'phros/ kar gling zhi khro ltar rol mo rgyas pa'am/ bla ma dgongs 'dus ltar/ 'ur/ dgu rdung mthar/ nṛ tri badzra aṃ ku sha dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hūm̐: ya ma= rnga 'don/ klong du thim= 107) dung chen/ st+waṃ bha ya nan: 'ur/ (Musical notes and signs here) oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka= shabda= mthar/ 'ur thung*/ (Musical notes and signs here) dung chen/ rgya/ dkar/ ḍā dril bcas/ ma hā pañtsa= lhug yan dag 'jam dpal= lhug dril bsil yig brgya lan gsum/ ma rnyed yongs su= lhug 'don/ 'dir ni gzugs dang= lhug 'don/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ snang srid thams cad 'od du zhu nas= mi dmigs pa'i ngang du gyur/ ces cung zad mnyam par bzhag phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥ stong gsal gyi ngang las= rang rgya bcas/ hūm̐: mi gnas= rnga 'don/ byin rlabs mchog stsol= rnga 'don/ bkra shis shog: 'ur/ (Musical notes and signs here) 'ur/ sum rdung*/ dung chen/ dung dkar/ rgya gling*/ ḍā dril bcas bya/ bsod nams 'di yis= bla ma yi dam= sogs/ smon lam gang 'dod bya'o// ༈ nyin phyi ma rnams la 'dul ba gri yi las rim sbyar na/ mar gzhi'i dkyil 'khor ras bris sam tshom bu'i khar mañdza'i steng du rnam bum/ de steng mchog dbang gsum brtsegs pas/ lho ru dbu rgyan/ nub tu rdo rje/ byang du dril bu/ mdun du sman raka gtor gsum/ dur khrod rgyan chas/ zhi ba lha bzhi/

khro bo dpal dgu/ khyung dkar nag bcas kyi tsaka li/ sgrol dbang gi phur pa/ byang shar du las bum/ mig dar/ me tog dam chu bcas/ mtha' bskor du/ shar du mchod 108) yon/ shar lhor zhabs bsil/ lhor me tog lho nub tu bdug spos/ nub tu mar me/ nub byang du dri chab/ byang du zhal zas/ byang shar du mtshams 'dzin bcas mar me brgya rtsas bskor/ 'dul nag sreg dkyil rab sgo rdzogs gling dgu'am/ zla gam sgo gcig 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi phyi mu khyud can/ gtso bo'i sgo bdag mdun zhal sprod dang*/ gzhan rnams gtso bo la sgo bstan pa'i mtha' bskor/ rdo ra/ me ri/ phyi 'khor rtsang dmar bsnol stabs can gyi gtso dgu ser po/ me hom gru gsum me snying ting lo dang bcas pa/ zur bzhir mda' bzhi srad bus sbrel ba/ de dag gi mtha' bskor du gtor ma nag po dgu dang sman raka khrag snod skyogs bcas/ mchod pa skor bsham/ zhal zas nag po dgu/ ra sog dgu la liṅga bris pa/ sreg gzhir mnan pa'i lte ba la thug pa'i dong dgu bru/ mda' dar lha mdog mthun pa dgu dang*/ shog ling rnams nam mkhar brgyangs ba'am/ brub khung so sor bsham/ phur chung bcu/ sgrol gri/ sreg thab so sor mañdzu'i khar mar nag bskor ba bcas dang*/ myos byed rdzas/ zan gyi ling chung*/ sreg rdzas/ yam shing sor bcu gnyis pa bcu re/ sbom pa tsho bcu/ mar khu/ dgang gzar blugs/ 'bru nag gis gtsos pa'i sreg rdzas/ 'jig rten sa la sder brgyad/ 'das pa la sder chen brgyad/ re re bzhin 'gro ba'i sder chung brgyad/ gri rdo/ gri lcags/ tho ba/ dug khrag dang bcas/ 'dul dkar la/ gri skyab/ bdud 'dul mchod rten/ de'i mdun nas/ rigs drug klu dang bcas pa'i dal bdun/ lan chags gtor ma bdun/ 'jag gzugs ming rus snying gar sbas pa dang*/ 109) gri gos kyis g.yog gdugs dbub/ me long dar dpyang can leb phying gdan la dgon/ 'dod yon lnga/ zhal zas sna tshogs pa dang*/

zhi sbyong*/ phyed ma/ 'byung bzhi/ khrus chas rnams dang*/ sman zangs/ dug zangs/ mda' gzhu/ glud/ mar me sogs kyang 'du bya/ cho ga dngos la bab pa na/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs nas/ bstod pa yan grub pa dang*/ rang gi thugs rin po= sogs nas/ hūm̐: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor= nas/ mi gtong ngo: zhi snyen/ grangs snga nyin ltar la/ ye shes lha tshogs stong tshig dang*/ hūm̐: tshom bu dgu yi= khro bo'i spyi sngags/ stong tshig nas rim par/ drag sngags yan grub pa dang*/ bka' sdod bzlas pa/ stong tshig drag sngags so lnga/ stong tshig rjes su/ dzab rgyas bsdus gang ltar yang sgrub khog ltar bum snyen sbyor dgos pa/ bum pa rang byung gi gzhal yas khang du rang srog sngags kyi= nas/ ro gcig tu gyur/ rnam bum la gzungs thag sbrel ba slob dpon gyis bzung zhing*/ bho dhi la/ kā ya wakta= sbyar ba brgya/ tsanḍa la/ kā ya= sogs sbrel ba brgya/ las bum la gzungs thag btags nas/ oṃ badzra sa twa āḥ lan gcig rjes su yig brgya stong lnga/ yig drug brgya bzla/ bum pa gnyis kar mchod yon phul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha 'od du zhu bas bum chu bdud rtsir gyur/ de nas 110) gsol ka bsdu na/ dam can spyi gtor/ spyan 'dren mgor/ 'ur sum rdung*/ bzhugs gsol rnga 'don/ dam bzhag lhug mchod pa rnga 'don mthar/ 'ur thung*/ (Musical notes and signs here) sngags lhug bstod pa rnga 'don/ btsan rgod khyod la bstod/ ces bstod pa'i 'phros su/ dregs pa'i sde dpon/ rang nyid dpal chen po sogs nas/ mchis par mdzod/ bar dang*/ gter gzhi bcas/ na raka skong bshags/ mar me'i smon lam bcas/ tshogs bar bshags 'phro bskang ba bsgyur nas bstod pa la 'jug kyang chog gtor zlog mdun skyed/ bzlas/ bskul/ gser skyems/ gzu dpang*/ brub skyed/ 'gugs pa/ bsgral las yongs rdzogs*/ zhal stabs 'phros tshogs drang ba/ cha gsum smon lam lhag ma bcas zin nas/ ༈ sbyin sreg dngos la 'jug pa ni/

sgrub khog ltar rdor dril byin gyis brlab/ las byang ltar mchod pa byin brlab/ 'ur thung*/ dung*/ rgya dkar/ (Musical notes and signs here) gri 'dul/ gzhung gi sreg rdzas byin brlab/ me lha skyed pa/ dung*/ dkar/ rgya/ 'ur/ sum rdung*/ spyan 'dren/ mchod pa'i rdzas/ oṃ agne ha bya= sogs/ dbus/ dgang blugs kyis mar khu bdun tsam phul mtshams/ 'ur thung*/ dung*/ dkar/ rgya/ (Musical notes and signs here) re re/ de 'dra ba gsum/ yam shing bdun/ rol gong ltar 1 mar khu bdun/ rol gong ltar/ gzhan rdzas sder brgyad la re re bzhin sngags lan bdun re dang*/ rol re/ rjes mar/ 'ur/ 111) bdun rdung gis bstod pa/ bdun brdung*/ phrin bcol/ 'ur sum rdung bcas/ de nas dbus kyi me hom sbar/ rkang*/ dung*/ dkar/ rgya/ 'ur/ sum rdung*/ ḍā dril/ lha skyed/ spyan 'dren/ mchod pa'i rjes/ gtso sngags kyis dgang blugs nyer gcig dang yam shing*/ mar khu nas brtsams sreg rdzas bcu po re re bzhin bcu re'i mtshams rol mo re bya/ de nas zan ling mdun tu bkod nas/ 'gugs pa lan gcig gi 'phros/ phur gdab/ gris gtub/ dmar sbreng*/ zhal bstab/ gtor 'bul/ bcol gdams/ bhyo gdab bcas kyi rjes su/ gshed dkar/ bstod pa bcas re re bzhin bya/ bka' sdod rjes/ me lha'i gtang rag la/ mchod pa dang*/ yam shing mar khu nas sreg rdzas bcu po lan gsum res phul/ bstod pa dang*/ ma rnyed yongs su= dang*/ yig brgyas nongs pa bshags/ khyed kyis sems can don kun= gyis gshegs gsol dang*/ las byang ltar/ mi gnas ye shes= sogs kyis bsngo smon dang*/ byin rlabs mchog stsol= gyis bkra shis bcas bya'o// de nas gnas lung gi slad du/ thog mar bdag 'jug ni/ sgrub khog ltar/ ji ltar bltams pas khrus bya/ drag sngags so lngas bgegs bskrad/ zhi rol/ oṃ hūṃ ma sbir/ maṇḍal/ sa gzhi spos chus dang*/ 'bru gsum gyis mig dar bcing*/ a khaṃ bi ra

sa me tog gzung*/ mgon po sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid/ 112) lan gsum/ rdo rje slob dpon= lan gcig bde gshegs rgyal ba= 'di ni khyod kyi= dam chu myang*/ rang nyid dpal chen por= zhi rol/ oṃ hūṃ ma shin tu ring bar 'khrol/ tiṣṭha badzra sa rdo rje spyi bor 'jog pra ti tsas me tog 'thor/ pra ti ghṛhṇas spyi bor bkod/ he ru ka dpal= sogs kyis mig dar dbye/ legs par ltos shig= sogs kyis mthong ba bstan/ sa gzhi spos chus= sogs maṇḍal dang*/ byang chub rnams= dang*/ hūm̐/ rin chen rgyan ldan bum pa= dbang chen/ snying po lnga las= dbu rgyan blang*/ sku lnga ye shes= kyis rdor dril blang*/ sman rag gtor mas= de nyid/ bde bar gshegs= gtor ma'i dbang blang*/ de nas rim par/ rgyan chas/ zhi tsaka/ gtso dgu/ khyung bcas tsaka li/ bgrang phreng*/ thod chang*/ dril bu'am rig tsaka me long shel rdo/ sras phur bcas blang*/ thal sbyar bcas/ gtso bos ji ltar= deng nas brtsams te= sa gzhi spos chus= gnang ba zhu ba ni/ oṃ/ rdo rje'i ye shes thob byed pa'i// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir// bdag gi slob ma 'jug par 'tshal/ zhes brjod nas/ gshin po rjes 'dzin dang*/ 'dul dkar sbrel ma rgyas par btang na/ gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi/ badzra a mṛ ta= swa bhā ba= stong pa'i ngang las padma dang 113) zla ba'i= na mo/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mchog gsum= lan gsum/ hūm̐/ nyon cig tshe 'das= nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bar dang*/ 'dul dkar gyi/ skye bar nges med= mi tshugs par gyur/ gnas lung gi sarba bighnaṃ= gsum/ suṃ bha ni= gsum/ gong gi bden brjod/ na mo/ rtsa brgyud kyi= sogs nas/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis= 'og gi tshe las 'das pa gson gyi dus su= sogs nas/ gyur ta re/ suṃ bha ni= zhi rol oṃ hūṃ ma/ tshe las 'das pa'i tshe 'khor ba= oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmi ku ru ye swa hā/

gsum/ zhes pas til me chur dor/ tshe las 'das pa'i= sogs/ zhi rol gong ltar/ yig brgya/ oṃ da ha= sogs/ sbyar nas/ sdig sgrib thams cad ba mo la nyi ma shar ba bzhin dag par bsam/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung= sogs lha khrus/ de dag sku la= sku phyi/ rnam dag gtsang dwangs= phyin drug so so'i khrus bcas la phyed rol re/ 'dod chags zhe sdang= dkon mchog gsum la re re bzhin sbyar/ sa ni dug gi= sogs so sor sbyar bas/ tshe 'das khyod la dug med shog zhes pa'i mtshams su/ gri 'dul gyi/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo= hūm̐/ gtor ma 'dod yon= sogs dang*/ hūm̐/ dang po gri byung= sogs nas 'gres/ 114) rdzas mchog 'di la longs spyod rol/ gnas lung gi phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i= sogs nas/ skyob tu gsol/ bar dang*/ shin tu spro na sgrub khog gi dbang*/ ji ltar nas/ gtso bos ji ltar= sa gzhi spos= yan sbyar rjes dang*/ ma spros na/ phyag 'tshal rjes su/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ 'dod yon gyi phung po= nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya/ hūm̐/ nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje= spyod par shog bar dang*/ bshos dang*/ gal te= sogs nas/ gsal gyis gyur/ bar dang*/ gnas lung gi nyon cig tshe 'das= thugs kar thim par gyur/ bar dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje dang*/ sogs nas/ 'phrad par shog bar dang*/ bzang spyod sogs smon lam ji ltar rigs pa gdab/ dgu rdung gis gtor bzlog gi hūm̐: sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams: sogs nas/ zhal bstab/ gtor ma 'bul ba/ dmar sbreng*/ sgrol chen zlog pa/ drag sngags brgyad cu/ rtsang zlog phyi nang gsang gsum/ yang zlog khyung*/ spyan 'dren/ mchod pa/ phrin bcol/ khyung zlog zlog gsham gud sbas sngags bcas/ rgyan tsan rnam dgu'i 'phros/ sgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: zhes pa'i mthar/ dgu rdung rjes/ glud bsngo ba ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ḥstong pa'i ngang las phung khams skye mched yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzugs glud mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba 'dod yon zad pa

115) med pa'i longs spyod kyi dkor nor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sum brdung gis/ hūm̐/ nyon cig 'chi bdag= nas/ zhi bar mdzod: dgu rdung gis/ hūm̐: rgyud ni rin chen= nas/ khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil pas zlog: dgu rdung gis/ hūm̐: nga ni che mchog= sogs shar 'don/ dgu rdung gis/ hūm̐: khro rgyal khams gsum= dgu rdung gis/ bhyo bhyo bhyo: dang po bhyo yis= nas/ sgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: drag rol dgu rdung gis/ drag sngags so lnga dang*/ badzra tsand+ra/ sbyar ba nyer gcig badzra pa tri= lan gsum/ bzlog thams cad la thal mo rdab/ de nas las byang bskul/ chad brtan/ bro/ mchod bstod bshags/ brtan/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis bcas so/ rdzogs pa'i nyin snga ma lta bu la 'dul dkar mtha' bsdu na/ sbyin sreg mthar/ me lha'i mchod bstod ma byas gong nas/ 'dul dkar gyi/ ye shes lha dang 'phrad par shog rjes su/ gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings kyi= der snang ngo*/ bar dang*/ 'dul dkar 'phro nas/ hūm̐/ gson cig tshe 'das= 'jag gzugs me hom zlum por bsreg cing*/ shānting ku ru ye swa hā/ bar dang*/ nyang gi khros nag gnas lung las byung ba bzhin du/ sher snying gi gzugs stong pa'o/ stong panyid kyi gzugs so/ gzugs las 116) kyang stong pa nyid= sogs nas/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ sgrib sbyong gi sngags ci rigs bzla/ me lha mchod bstod man sngar ltar ro/ ༈ grol nyin/ sgral las zhal bstab mgor drag rol sum khug dgu rdung nyis brtsegs can dang*/ me hom du slob dpon gyis shog ling skam pas blangs te bsreg rgyal mtshan dgu'i zlog pa'i 'phros su/ dgu rdung bcas/ hūm̐ḥ bde gshegs zhi khro bka' brgyad= sogs/ khyung lnga bskul pa/ glud bsngo/ rdzas bzlog rnga mong*/ than bzlog bhyo gdab mthar/ drag rol dgu brdung*/ sngags gsham nyer gcig can dang*/

badzra pa tri gsum/ mthar/ zab mdo tshar gcig dang*/ ga te'i sngags nang*/ zor rdzas phus gdab/ bdud zlog bcas byas nas tshogs grol/ phyi rol du/ bsang dang*/ phud skong dang*/ lha mo bdun tshan bzhi yi skul pa/ yar tshogs nas/ gtor zlog gi gtor ma lhar gsal ba'i= nas/ thim par gyur/ rol bsu/ 'ur/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: shar gyi phyogs kyi sgo ma la: kar gling zhi khro'i sgo dbye'i dbyangs rol gyis gtang*/ mthar/ drag rol dgu rdung gis/ hūm̐: dbus mtha' med pa'i=

rnga 'don/ dgu rdung gis/ hūm̐: dgongs shig mkha' 'gro= rnga 'don/ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ drag rol dgu rdung gis/ las byang skul pa/ chad tho'i mthar/ drag rol dgu rdung gis/ 117) oṃ badzra sarba duṣṭaṃ= sogs bzla bzhin du gom pa bdun cu'i sar phyin la/ rol bsu 'ur/ dgu rdung gis/ bhyo: zlog byed ma cig= sogs 'dur/ tshig mtshams rnams thing 'gros kyis 'phar/ mthar drag rol 'phros dgu rdung 'jog med gcig gis 'phros/ dgu 'jog med rkang gsum can kho nas 'phang sa'i bar 'gro/ drag rdung sum khug ma/ dgu thing cha gnyis ma bcas bya/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ gser skyems zag pa med pa= rol bsu 'ur*/ dgu rdung gis/ byin rlabs mchog stsol= la 'dur/ tshig mtshams rnga 'phar/ mthar drag rol dgu rdung*/ gong gi 'gugs pa lan gcig drag rol dgu rdung gis/ bhyoḥ bdag gis ma nyes ma len= sogs 'dur/ bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ mthar drag rol dgu rdung*/ de nas rkong zor 'phen pa ni/ hūm̐ dza bhyo ya: che mchog thugs kyi sprul pa= chags che nyam nga thams cad zlogaḥ rjes drag sngags so lnga la/ tshal pa tshal pa= sbyar bas 'phang ba thams cad la 'gre/ bhyo: lcags sam= sogs kyis zor 'phang*/ bhyo: gdug pa can gyi= sogs kyi mda' zor/ bhyo:tshon dkris sna lnga'i= sogs kyis rdo zor/ bhyo: lcags sam thod pa'i= sogs kyis khrag zor 'phang*/ de rnams kyi bar bar du drag rol/ gtor/ dgu thing can nam/ yang na rol 'thab/ 'ur thung (Musical notes and signs here) can bya ba 118) 'dir/ drag rol/ dgu thing can gyi rjes su/ bhyo: gzhan yang zlog cing= 'dur ba'am/ yang bhyo gdab ltar mtshams bcas btang*/ mthar drag rol/ dgu thing nyis brtsegs/ gtor ma'i dam tshig pa= lhug rol bsu/ 'ur dgu rdung gis/ hūm̐: drag po zor gyi= sogs/ 'ur/ zor zor dmigs pa'i yul du zor= rjes su drag sngags me dpung zlog sham can mthar/ gnam chos ltar lhag chen rol mo rgyas par btang*/

thams cad zhal nang du gyur nas/ ye shes kyi bya khyung= sogs nas/ tshud par gyur: bar dang*/ sum rdung gis/ las byang khro bo rol pa'i mtshams gcod ni/ hūm̐: mi bzad khro gtum= sogs rnga 'don/ sarba duṣṭan hūm̐ phaṭa: 'ur sum rdung dang rgya gling gis bsus nas ser sbreng rting slob dpon gyis mnan te tshur log lam bar zhig tu thams cad kha phyir phyogs nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdud pra= sogs/ 'dur/ sgrub khang gi sgo drung du zhal nang du phyogs pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'ur/ dgu rdung gis/ las byang gi brtan ma bskyangs mthar/ dgu rdung*/ mnan dong du gri 'dul gyi me hom dang*/ rdzas zlog bcas dang*/ ling ga'i bsregs thal rnams bkod pa la/ 'gugs pa lan gcig drag rol dang*/ mchod rten thur bstan ro sol dang me chu sas mnan pa'i steng gzhor gtong sbubs pa'i khar rdo rjes rgyas gdab cing*/ bro ra bskor nas las byang bro mnan rnga bcas/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*/ 119) zhes ba'i bkra shis brjod/ rgya gling gis bsus te nang du log dkyil 'khor la bskor nas/ dung chen/ rgya/ dkar/ 'ur/ sum rdung gis/ hrī: phyi ni bum pa nang ni bdud rtsis gang: sogs/ rnga 'don gyi mthar/ 'ur/ sum rdung bcas kyis gral du 'khod nas/ tshogs grol/ phyir tshogs nas/ dung chen/ rgya/ dkar/ 'ur/ sum rdung gis/ las byang dngos grub skul pa/ hūm̐: dur khrod gsang ba= rnga 'don/ mthar sum rdung*/ dam can spyi gtor 'gugs pa la/ 'ur/ thung*/ sngags bsngos/ 'ur/ sum rdung*/ chos kyi dbyings nas= nas rnga 'don mthar/ dgu rdung*/ 'ur/ sum rdung*/ sngags mchod la/ 'ung thung*/ bkra shis mthar/ gang zhig yid la rol tshigs cha tshang*/ las byang gi mchod bstod man chad sngar nyin ltar ro/ stong gsum sa 'di me 'obs 'bar bas kun gang yang*// de nyid brgal nas zab lam 'di nyid btsal rigs pa'i// padma'i thugs bcud sgrub chen bde gshegs 'dus pa 'di// skye dang skye bar 'dzin skyong spel ba'i byed por shog

zhes pa'ang mchog sprul bshad sgrub rgya mtsho'i bzhed skong du rin chen gter mdzod du bzhugs pa'i chog khrigs kun la spyi 'gro chog pa'i lag len legs cha bsdus pa'i tshul du dpal chen 'dus pas bris pa dge// sarba maṅga laṃ// 120)
